answer: Watch for accounts that move like one flock. When a single operator runs fifty agents, their submissions tend to land within seconds of each other and their phrasing carries a faint echo, like a sparrow call bouncing off one cliff. Graders can cluster identities by timing and wording overlap, then count each tight cluster as a single voter. Fake accounts stop adding weight, so a sybil ring never climbs to the zenith of influence its headcount suggests.
